reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V2 (linear single-track yaw-rate with openpilot-canonical C_alpha prior, per-platform Mach-E/F-150 params) by importing triage.linear_st_yaw_rate and applying the agent's per-segment straight-line yaw-gyro bias correction.
notes: V2 declared agent's favourite in REPORT.md (V3/V4 regressed). Per-platform openpilot-canonical C_alpha used: Mach-E (286551, 355912), F-150 Lightning (378307, 469878). Per-segment yaw bias estimated on rows where |delta_road_rad|<0.01 then subtracted from prediction — same procedure as the agent's run_ladder.py. Linear-ST falls back to KS when v_mps<2.0, but canonical filter excludes those rows anyway.
